# Bid the units, the type, and the extras.

> Price a skylight install from unit count, tubular versus fixed versus solar-venting, replace-existing versus new cut-in, asphalt versus tile/metal versus low-slope, and extras — plus the walk-away price an $800 / unit special cannot see.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
